title: Vulnerability posture dashboard (internal tool)
story: Built in my current contract role.

caseStudy.label: Problem
caseStudy.body: Scanner data was scattered everywhere, and vulnerability data was tracked in weekly and monthly spreadsheets.

caseStudy.label: What I built
caseStudy.body: An internal dashboard that unifies scanner data from multiple vulnerability scanners (cloud, container image, and network/host) into a single view. Stack: Python.

caseStudy.label: What it shows
caseStudy.body: Each product's current vulnerability posture, plus weekly and quarterly vulnerability-management posture per product. SLA metrics include SLA attainment, burndown ratio, and MTTR. Product teams use it to see the security posture of their own products.

caseStudy.label: Outcome
caseStudy.body: It replaced the weekly and monthly vulnerability spreadsheets and made it easy for product teams to look into the security side of their product.
